tasks.subject: Create config.js — all building dimensions and site layout
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the single source of truth for all compound dimensions, colors, camera, and lighting.

**Files:**
- Create: `config.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] All six structures defined
- [ ] Ends with `export { CONFIG };`
- [ ] Every numeric value has a `// ft` comment

**Verify:** Browser console → `CONFIG.mainHouse.width` → `70`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["config.js"], "verifyCommand": "console: CONFIG.mainHouse.width", "acceptanceCriteria": ["All structures defined", "Named export", "ft comments"]}
```

tasks.subject: Create buildings.js — geometry generators from config
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure functions that return THREE.Group meshes for every structure.

**Files:**
- Create: `buildings.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] createMainHouse — clerestory geometry
- [ ] createGableBuilding — reusable for 4 outbuildings
- [ ] createGround, createPatio
- [ ] No scene.add() inside functions

**Verify:** All buildings visible in scene.html

```json:metadata
{"files": ["buildings.js"], "verifyCommand": "http://localhost:8080/scene.html — all buildings visible", "acceptanceCriteria": ["createMainHouse clerestory", "createGableBuilding reusable", "Pure functions"]}
```

tasks.subject: Create controls.js — live panel + orbit/walkthrough camera switcher
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Floating HTML slider panel + camera mode switching.

**Files:**
- Create: `controls.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Panel updates CONFIG and calls onRebuild
- [ ] F → walkthrough, Escape → orbit
- [ ] HUD badge shows mode

**Verify:** Slider updates geometry; F/Escape switches camera modes

```json:metadata
{"files": ["controls.js"], "verifyCommand": "Drag slider → rebuild; F → walk; Escape → orbit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Live panel", "Camera switching", "HUD badge"]}
```
